claire (Billing): spotting a mismatch on AWS MP settlement S-2026-4102. Partner billed reseller WaveBridge at tier B rates but CSV shows tier A. Delta ~ $6,300. Can someone quick-check before we push settlement?
omar (Revenue Ops): do we have the partner price tariff they used?
claire (Billing): posted CSV to /finance/marketplace/inbound/S-2026-4102.csv. snippet: ```account,units,price_tier
wavebridge-eu,12000,tierA
``` but invoice PDF lists tierB per line item.
settlement-bot: S-2026-4102 processed 2026-08-01T02:10Z. Alert: tier mismatch detected between invoice PDF and settlement CSV. Status: FLAGGED.
linh (Partner Ops): pinging WaveBridge rep now. Likely export mapping issue where tier label differs between portal and billing export. I'll request corrected settlement file and confirmation of intended tier.
omar (Revenue Ops): financial impact > threshold. If partner confirms tierB, we accept invoice. If wrong, request credit note for $6.3k and hold settlement.
claire (Billing): created ticket FIN-7782. Holding settlement until partner response. Will update when corrected CSV or credit note attached.
